name: wwjd
description: What Would Johannes Do: opinionated UI/UX rules and workflow. Three skills (wwjd for structure, behaviour and copy; wwjd-look for the look; wwjd-animation for motion), a cold critic agent on request, a prompt hook that routes UI work, and an auto-lint hook after UI edits.

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.description: 1 safe, close to the kit · 3 one loud axis (default) · 5 art-directed, a distinct idea per page

budget.title: Surface budget
budget.description: 1 lean (every budget −2) · 3 as written (default) · 5 generous (+2); overflow rules always apply

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: auto picks by register (default); or force a motion theme

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: 1 terse, labels only · 3 plain (default) · 5 warm, a little personality in empty and success states

rigor.title: Rigor
rigor.description: 1 one shot, lint only · 3 lint + one look (default) · 5 critic, fit and runtime checks, variants

grade.title: Grade gate
grade.description: gate: write a grade sheet for each over-budget surface before building it (default) · light: grade in your head, list the cuts in the handover
